steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: The... the Yetis...

steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: ...I feel so bad for them to all die in Lungmen like that. One less hope, one less legend for the Infected.

steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: Move it. The L. G. D. are on the way.

steps.name: Nine
steps.text: I know.

steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: ...There's something not quite right about your eyes.

steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: To be honest, I always thought you were a spy for Lungmen.

steps.name: Nine
steps.text: How about now?

steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: No one would believe it anyway.

steps.name: Nine
steps.text: A real spy would kill you to keep you quiet.

steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: I'm not worried about you killing me. Look at the state of Lungmen. Even if you were a Lungmenite, you can't go back.

steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: You'd have an even worse time than we did.

steps.name: Nine
steps.text: ...So I'm not. I'm not really anything anymore.

steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: What are you doing? Wow, is that a flower?

steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: Oooh, is this your Arts? It's pretty.

steps.name: Nine
steps.text: Someone has to leave them a token of respect.

steps.name: Censor
steps.text: Such dilly-dallying... such a waste of time.
I think it was well done. I can give top marks for wiping out the entire Reunion Movement in the city of Lungmen in a single day.
Wei Yenwu is impressive.
Taihe, have you heard that rumor?

steps.name: Censor
steps.text: You speak of Wei Yenwu's history?

steps.name: Taihe
steps.text: Delve not into such things.
Forgive me. But how do the skills of the Black Cloaks compare to those of the Imperial Guard?

steps.name: Censor
steps.text: Hmph. You overestimate them. But they do indeed have some exceptional skill...

steps.name: Taihe
steps.text: Look out!
You bastards!!!

steps.name: Censor
steps.text: ——Infected?
Hiss!

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: ——Wire?!
You don't really want to kill me, do you? You can use Arts.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: I've always heard that men who use wires as weapons are all, literally all, psychopaths.
Indeed, they do say that...

steps.name: Censor
steps.text: Infected, do not interfere with official business. Take care that I lump you in with the others.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Not much to be done about unidentified armed units getting killed on the battlefield, is there?
We can likewise testify that you are acting in coordination with Reunion.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: You don't have the authority to investigate my partner.
We are well aware that a vessel belonging to an 'Infected Countermeasures Specialist' is docked in a Lungmen berth, Superintendent Ch'en. This is the only reason Miss Blaze has not yet come to harm.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Then how much more do you need to see? How much more must you test the people of this city with their very lives?

steps.name: Censor
steps.text: Speak with respect. We are assessing Lungmen's risk control capabilities due to the importance with which we regard you.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Then forgive me. I'll rephrase.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Are you enjoying this farce?

steps.name: Censor
steps.text: Pfft.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Stand down, Blaze. We do not serve these fine, upstanding individuals, and they're not with the raincoats either.
Apologies, Miss Blaze. I hope I did not cause you any displeasure.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: ...You're very polite. But your tone pisses me off.
You have an ear for Yan speech.
You inherited much from your father. Alas, now you are but an Infected. Your path is rough. And short.

steps.name: Taihe
steps.text: Come.
Goodbye then, Miss Blaze, Superintendent Ch'en.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Wait! What did you just say about my dad?!

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Stop!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Blaze!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Remember the mission!

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Right.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Officer Ch'en.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: We found no trace of the enemy commander.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Which?

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: We only know of Mephisto.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Let Rhodes Island handle the rest.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: No need to rush into it. This campaign is all but over.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: But he has to pay... for the atrocities he committed.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Then we'll leave it to you.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Let's part ways for now. I have one more thing I need to see with my own eyes.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Wait a minute, L. G. D. lady.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: What is it?

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: ...Thanks for that, back there.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: That's all.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Sure. You too.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Why did you have to pick that moment to act? Blaze... You're not the type to make mistakes at a time like this.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: For one thing, I was really mad...

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: For another, I could tell that L. G. D. lady, Ch'en, was getting mad too.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: We also can't tell which of the two sides has the right to speak.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: So I pick the one I like.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Sorry. It won't happen again.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: ...No, Blaze. It's my turn to say it won't happen again.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: But I can't say that. I can't promise that.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: The Yetis...

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Silly rabbit.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Hey, don't pat my head. I need to get taller...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: ...At least, don't pat it too long.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: I know, I know.
How do you feel?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: I was in the neighborhood.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Your emotional state is fluctuating. It seems you had a deeper interaction with this Reunion unit in the Chernobog ruins.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: As far as I can tell, the captain of this unit did not participate in the battle.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Lungmen won't keep chasing these Infected. But Rhodes Island has to do more.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Lungmen won't interfere with what happens next. And you can choose not to participate.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: ...But you will participate. Whether the Infected is codenamed 'Mephisto' or 'FrostNova.'

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: I have my work cut out for me.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Oh, and Dr. {@nickname}......

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Don't look at me like that.

options: Stop with the cloak and dagger.
Amiya said Rhodes Island needs trust.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: But you and I don't need trust.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: You need the trust of Rhodes Island's operators, not me.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: ——I know you too well to trust you. Just like you never trusted me, in the old days.

options: How would I know the old days?
Is there anything I can do about it now?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Right.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: I misspoke. Forget it.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Be careful in the next operation. Only the most dangerous of commanders would train such a squad of Infected who would fight to the death without flinching.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Of course, it's up to you if you want to see it through to the end.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: And do conserve your energy. We may not have time to rest.

options: The battle for Lungmen is over.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: It's not that simple. At least, that's what I think.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Dr. {@nickname}, from now on, it's up to you to decide if you will shoulder the burden of responsibility for Rhodes Island...

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: ...'Whether or not to be one worthy of the trust of a Rhodes Island operator.'

steps.name: Phantom Crossbowman
steps.text: Ah, FrostNova, ma'am, you're awake...

steps.name: Phantom Crossbowman
steps.text: ...Take it easy! Let me help you.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: I'm fine. I'm not... so fragile.

steps.name: Phantom Crossbowman
steps.text: Where are you going? You can't go back.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: Then, my brothers and sisters...

steps.name: Phantom Crossbowman
steps.text: ...You can't go back!

steps.name: Phantom Crossbowman
steps.text: It was for your sake that they...

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: Don't insult my squad!

steps.name: Phantom Crossbowman
steps.text: Ugh!

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: They did... *cough* look out for me.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: But it was for the Infected that they gave their lives so bravely!

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: They fought their last battle so that more of their people could live, not for the sake of any one person!

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: *Cough* *cough hack* *cough*...

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: *Cough* Guh... Mmg...

steps.name: Phantom Crossbowman
steps.text: FrostNova, ma'am...

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: Enough with the ma'am. Are you calling me that because I look weak to you?

steps.name: Phantom Crossbowman
steps.text: Sorry!

steps.name: Phantom Crossbowman
steps.text: It's just, they put you in our care like this.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: And now they're gone, and I never got to keep my promises to them.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: I don't even have a chance to make amends.

steps.name: Phantom Crossbowman
steps.text: FrostNova...

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: ...The one slumped at the wall there.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: Mephisto.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: He's still unconscious?

steps.name: Phantom Crossbowman
steps.text: We don't know. He's been like that the whole time. He says nothing. Does nothing.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: Take him back. It's enough.

steps.name: Phantom Crossbowman
steps.text: Understood. Phew, I thought you'd...

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: I'd what?

steps.name: Phantom Crossbowman
steps.text: I thought you'd kill him.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: There's no need for that anymore. I think I know what happened outside the slums.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: That disheartened look in his eyes...

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: ...And, from time to time...

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: I recall that day, three or four years ago, when he tried his very hardest to sing.

steps.name: Phantom Crossbowman
steps.text: He can sing? But Faust said, his throat...

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: He really tried.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: Just like all of us Infected. Though we will all someday succumb to Oripathy...

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: We still try our very hardest to live.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: Let the rest of his life continue to punish him.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: Tell me, Phantom Crossbowman, was Rhodes Island involved in that fight?

steps.name: Phantom Crossbowman
steps.text: Do you mean...?

steps.name: Phantom Crossbowman
steps.text: ...No, as far as I know, they didn't fight the Yetis.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: ...So childish.

steps.name: Phantom Crossbowman
steps.text: Are you sure you want to stay?

steps.name: Phantom Crossbowman
steps.text: They may not come after us, FrostNova. You don't have to die here.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: I met a few people in the ruins. I want to see them again.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: I promised them, actually.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: And I know they're coming.

steps.name: Phantom Crossbowman
steps.text: FrostNova...

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: Go on, brother.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: Reunion lost this battle. And just maybe, Reunion did wrong.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: But you haven't. You still have a choice, you can do better.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: Go on. And don't look back.
